orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.subtitle: What we ordered from suppliers, from 2024 onward. Open one for its lines and the deliveries received against it.
orders.detailSubtitle: An order to a supplier as recorded: its lines, totals, and the goods receipts raised against it.

empty.title: No purchase orders
empty.text: Nothing matches these filters at once.

orders.noReceipts: Nothing received against this order yet.
orders.newSubtitle: Raise an order on a supplier. The number is assigned automatically from the category series.
orders.editSubtitle: Correct the order as recorded. Once a delivery has been received against it, only the dates, address and notes may change.
orders.deleteBody: Its {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} go with it. This cannot be undone.
orders.linesLocked: A delivery has already been received against this order, so its lines can no longer be changed.

form.supplierLocked: A delivery has been recorded against this order, so its supplier can no longer be changed.
form.categoryHint: Decides the number series and which measurements the lines carry.

orders.nothingReceivedBody: Nothing has arrived against this order yet. Open its goods receipt to record what came in — a partial delivery is fine.

period.label: Raised
period.inRange: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} in this period

row.expectedLate: expected {date} · {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
row.moreLines: {count, plural, one {# more line} other {# more lines}}

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.subtitle: What actually arrived from suppliers, note by note. Search by receipt, order or invoice number, supplier, or what was delivered; filter by what kind of thing it was. Open one for its lines against the order.
receipts.detailSubtitle: A delivery note as recorded: what arrived, line by line, against the order it was for, and the invoice it was billed on.
receipts.searchPlaceholder: Search receipt, order or invoice no., supplier…
receipts.empty: No goods receipts match these filters.
receipts.editSubtitle: Correct the delivery as recorded. The order it was received against cannot be changed.
receipts.deleteBody: Its {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} go with it, and the received quantities on the order go back down.

form.orderLocked: The order cannot be changed once the receipt exists.

detail.notInvoicedBody: No purchase invoice names this receipt. Once the supplier invoices it, the two can be linked.
detail.noScanBody: The paper the driver left is not attached to this receipt.

preview.title: Document {numero}
preview.hint: Generated from the record as it stands now. It is not stored — it re-renders each time.
preview.noScan: No scanned document on this note.
